name: enigmatrix-backend
description: Backend de Enigmatrix: pruebas, scripts y herramientas (las funciones viven en functions/)

scripts.build: npm run build:solutions && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:solutions && vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-enigmatrix --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator
